findings.what: With the Rails log switched on (LOGGING_RAILS_LOG_ENABLED=true), the entry Rails writes for an error has one more part on 7.2.4. When the error was raised while handling another error, 7.2.4 adds a blank line, a line 'Causes:' and one line per cause after the first line of the entry. Measured with a malformed JSON body sent to the API: 7.1.6 logs 'ActionDispatch::Http::Parameters::ParseError (...)' and the trace; 7.2.4 logs the same and, in between, 'Causes:' and 'JSON::ParserError (unexpected token at '{not json')'. It is in none of the seven changelogs; the source is the installed code. This is the only difference in 1060 Rails log lines per side beyond the Completed and Rendered difference the stage already declares. The response is the same (400), and the application's own request log is the same. The notes say of the earlier sample that no other log line differs; that sample had no error with a cause. The author adds one sentence to the Rails log declaration.
findings.where: exec/stages/S3/notes.md and pr-body.md, the third declared change (the Rails request log); source: actionpack 7.2.4 lib/action_dispatch/middleware/debug_exceptions.rb, log_error

findings.what: The console prompt changes. On 7.1.6 an operator sees 'irb(main):001>'. On 7.2.4 they see 'postal(prod)>' in production (the application name and the environment, no line number). The banner line and the results are the same. Listed in the Railties 7.2 changelog as 'Rails console now indicates application name and the current Rails environment'. No response, no stored data and no server process is affected. It matters only to a script that drives the console and waits for the old prompt.
findings.where: the Rails console (bin/rails console, which is what 'postal console' starts)

findings.what: Carried from all four earlier reviews, still open: json is not pinned below 3 in the Gemfile, and the plan put the pin in S2. Active Support 7.2 and 8.0 pass an option that json 3 removed. The lock holds json 2.7.1 and JSON responses work on 7.2.4 (this round's API and remote form responses). The only thing holding json below 3 is rubocop in the development group. Belongs to S2's follow-up or to S4 before its relock. The notes list it as a follow-up.

The fourth review's defect is fixed, and we confirmed it. The Rails log difference is declared with both sources and with who needs telling, and the count of declared changes is three. The three new examples pass on 7.2.4 and all three fail against the 7.1.6 lock, as the notes say. The spec restores the loggers it replaces: the request specs pass in three random orders. Earlier fixes also hold: against the 7.1.6 lock the two HEAD examples and the two migration waiter examples fail, and the lock differs from S2 only in what the stage lists.

The part of the application no check and no earlier review had run answers the same on both versions: 187 responses, 184 identical to the byte and 3 that differ only in the clock or a random boundary. Along the way we met 9 requests that answer 500 on 7.1.6 and on 7.2.4 alike. None is caused by this stage. They are: the raw HTML view of a message that has no HTML part (3), a message id that does not exist (2), the deliveries list asked for as JSON (1), a route posted with an unknown endpoint type (2), and the new message form posted with blank fields (1). Worth a ticket outside the upgrade, next to route.rb:119.

What the application sends to Sentry is the same on both versions for the six requests we tried: 3 events, same exception types, cause chain, transaction names and level. No earlier review had compared this.

Still open from earlier reviews, and the notes say so: the author did not run bin/rails app:update; the client has column names for stored 'Astana' values but no query; the seventh change under S3 in out/plan.json still asks for the withdrawn secret key declaration; db/schema.rb still says Schema[7.1] and will be restamped by the next migration run in development.

upstream_diff.why_not: We read every patch in upstream.json again (two are cut short by the recorder: the removed 7.0 defaults file and the added 7.1 defaults file) and every row of answer_key.json. None of the 11 files is a break this stage needed. The explicit YAML coder on the two serialized columns: both columns resolve to the YAML coder on 7.2.4 without it and a webhook payload round trips through the database as YAML on both versions (this round's probe). Replacing dynamic_form: their choice; the invalid forms in this round's walk render the same error list on both versions. The three framework defaults files belong to the config stage. db/schema.rb and the two annotate rake files belong to S2 and the 8.1 hop. lib/migration_waiter.rb and config/environments/test.rb carry the same change on both sides. Their Gemfile pins json below 3 and this one does not (finding 3). Their work mentions none of the three declared differences and neither of this round's two.
